about: Reviewed identity mapping for scripts/cloud-archive.mjs. An entry names an identity's kind (agent or organisation) and label on reviewed evidence, never from a display name. Match by `login` (a GitHub noreply login) or by `emailSha256` (SHA-256 of the exact, lower-cased author address; the address itself is never stored). Anything not listed stays as git shows it: a linked account, a [bot] automation login, or an unlinked author. Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer can check.
